output.answer: Bumble Inc. went public on February 11, 2021, when its Class A common stock began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol BMBL. The IPO had priced on February 10, 2021 at $43 per share (above the $37–$39 target range), with 50 million shares sold for gross proceeds of about $2.2 billion; on the first day the stock closed up 63.5%, valuing Bumble at roughly $7.7 billion.
caveats: The SEC prospectus (424B4) is dated February 10, 2021 (the pricing date) and was filed February 12, 2021; trading began February 11, 2021 — different 'IPO dates' appear in different sources depending on whether pricing or first trading day is meant.
IPO-related facts (price, proceeds, market cap) are as of February 2021 and describe the offering at that time; Bumble's stock and market value have changed substantially since.

passages.quote: Shares of [Bumble](https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/BMBL?qsearchterm=), which operates a dating app under the same name, closed up 63.5% in their initial public offering Thursday on the Nasdaq.

The company's stock began trading up nearly 77% at $76 per share under the ticker symbol "BMBL." It [priced the shares](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2021/02/10/2173640/0/en/Bumble-Inc-Prices-2-2-Billion-IPO.html) at $43 apiece, above its target range of $37 to $39, and sold 50 million shares.
The underwriters expect to deliver the shares of our Class A common stock against payment in New York, New York on or about February 16, 2021.

output.question: What is Bumble's IPO date?

key_facts.fact: Bumble's IPO date was February 11, 2021, when BMBL began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
The IPO priced on February 10, 2021 at $43 per share, above the $37–$39 target range, with 50 million Class A shares sold for gross proceeds of about $2.2 billion.
On its first trading day BMBL opened at about $76 (up ~77%) and closed up 63.5%, giving Bumble a market capitalization of about $7.7 billion.
The final IPO prospectus (Form 424B4) is dated February 10, 2021 and was filed with the SEC on February 12, 2021; share settlement was expected on or about February 16, 2021.
